_metadata.description: Per-component preview harness that executes real React inside an isolated iframe, wired via @vrooli/iframe-bridge.

requirements.title: Per-component harness page renders the actual React component (not placeholder HTML)
requirements.description: API serves `GET /preview/{component_id_or_library_id}/harness.html` returning an HTML shell that imports the component's bundled source and mounts it via `ReactDOM.createRoot`. The harness resolves optional `version` and `story` query params from indexed `story.json`, supports stable `libraryId` URLs for external capture tooling, posts identity-correlated `preview-ready`/`preview-error`, accepts only validated data-only temporary args override/reset messages for its own story, and preserves same-origin runtime imports.

validation.notes: Preview module tests prove the harness returns real same-origin HTML, inlines the bundled component module, includes runtime import maps, and posts preview-ready. TestModule_HarnessAcceptsLibraryID covers stable `libraryId` route IDs used by experience-component capture.

requirements.title: Reload-on-save: editor save triggers iframe NAV via the host bridge
requirements.description: After the editor PUT succeeds, the UI invokes the host-side `@vrooli/iframe-bridge` NAV message to reload the harness. Warm reload latency target is < 1s on a 50KB component on a developer-class machine.

validation.ref: ui/src/features/components/ComponentEditor.test.tsx::reloads the iframe when save returns a new sha256
validation.notes: The editor iframe URL includes the returned sha/retry key as a cache-buster; saves that change content force a new harness navigation.

requirements.title: Preview iframe is served same-origin from the library API with sandbox attributes
requirements.description: The harness page is served by the library's own API on a dedicated harness path so the bridge can inspect freely. The `<iframe>` carries the sandbox attribute set documented in `ui-health`; no third-party origins are loaded.

validation.notes: api/handlers/preview/module_test.go asserts the harness route returns HTML with same-origin /preview/runtime imports, stable `libraryId` route ids resolve, and runtime routes serve JavaScript. ui/src/features/components/ComponentEditor.test.tsx asserts the iframe uses the harness URL and sandbox attributes. ui/server.test.js asserts the production UI server proxies /preview harness and runtime paths to the API before SPA fallback, preventing recursive loading of the library UI inside the iframe. bas/cases/preview/preview-renders-component.json catches the user-visible recursion symptom through test-genie playbooks. ui/scripts/preview-e2e.mjs drives Chrome through the real UI and asserts preview frames remain /preview/... routes.

requirements.title: Preview runtime honors declared React ranges
requirements.description: The preview harness resolves declared `react` and `react-dom` dependency ranges to the newest supported runtime candidate, serves the vendored React runtime from same-origin `/preview/runtime/...` URLs, and surfaces an in-iframe import-map diagnostic when the resolved runtime is unavailable locally. Runtime imports are guarded with dynamic imports so module failures render in `#preview-error` instead of leaving a blank iframe.

validation.notes: api/internal/deps/semver_test.go covers range-to-latest resolution for wildcard, caret, tilde, comparator, compound, exact, missing, and unparseable ranges. api/handlers/preview/static_test.go verifies React imports point at same-origin /preview/runtime URLs, unavailable vendored runtime versions render diagnostics while falling back to React 18.3.1, harness CSS contains the design tokens/Tailwind app utilities, and runtime/component import failures are inside a catchable dynamic-import path. api/handlers/preview/module_test.go verifies the React runtime routes serve ESM with the named exports consumed by compiled JSX and ReactDOM client (`jsx`, `jsxs`, `Fragment`, `createRoot`, `hydrateRoot`) without esm.sh or dynamic CommonJS require leakage.

requirements.title: Preview bundler resolves relative imports and local dependency runtimes
requirements.description: The preview bundler uses esbuild Build with a source-directory ResolveDir so relative imports are bundled into the component module. Bare package imports remain external and are resolved by a per-preview import map. Non-React declared dependencies resolve through the same semver range function used by the deps domain and map to same-origin `/preview/runtime/npm/<package>@<version>/...` URLs when the package version is installed locally; unresolved ranges surface an import-map diagnostic.

validation.notes: api/internal/preview/service_test.go::TestEsbuilderBundlesRelativeImports proves Build-based relative import bundling. api/handlers/preview/static_test.go::TestBuildImportMapJSONPinsDeclaredDeps verifies non-React dependencies map to same-origin runtime URLs with no esm.sh, and TestBuildImportMapJSONUsesResolvedDependencyVersionPerBundle proves conflicting declared ranges produce independent import maps.

requirements.title: Preview failures surface in the host UI
requirements.description: The harness posts identity-correlated `preview-error` messages to the parent when render setup fails or the component has no callable export. The host editor correlates messages with the registered component/example/version/frame, renders a retryable error only on the failed specimen, and reserves a gallery-level failure state for the case where every preview is unavailable.

validation.notes: api/handlers/preview/static_test.go asserts harness render failures post `preview-error`. ui/src/features/components/ComponentEditor.test.tsx asserts a `preview-error` message renders the failure panel and retry reloads the iframe with a fresh retry key. ui/scripts/preview-e2e.mjs asserts the live preview reaches the Rendered badge and has no host or in-iframe preview error. `pnpm type-check`, `pnpm lint`, targeted Go preview tests, and `pnpm run test:preview-e2e` passed.
